description: Source code for EDAC (Error Detection and Correction) shell commands in Zephyr RTOS, including error injection, ECC and parity error reporting, and device control functions.

methods.name: decode_ecc_error
methods.description: Decodes and prints details of an ECC error based on the error code.

methods.name: ecc_error_show
methods.description: Retrieves and displays ECC error log information.

methods.name: parity_error_show
methods.description: Retrieves and displays parity error log information.

methods.name: cmd_edac_info
methods.description: Displays EDAC status and error counts.

methods.name: cmd_inject_addr
methods.description: Gets or sets the physical memory address for error injection.

methods.name: cmd_inject_mask
methods.description: Gets or sets the address mask for error injection.

methods.name: get_error_type
methods.description: Returns a string description of the error type.

methods.name: set_error_type
methods.description: Sets the error type for injection.

methods.name: cmd_inject_test
methods.description: Performs a default error injection test.
